error.route_in_use: These sensors need routes the filter leaves out (a train sensor needs the full feed), delete them first: {sensors}

error.route_not_found: This route is not in the data source
error.stop_incorrect: Start and/or End destination incorrect, possibly no transport 'today' or not in same direction, check logs
error.no_data_file: Data collection issue: URL incorrect or filename not in the correct folder
error.no_zip_file: Data collection issue: ZIP file not in the correct folder

abort.no_change: The data source already holds these routes, nothing to rebuild
abort.rebuild_started: Rebuilding the data source with the chosen routes. The current database stays in use until the new one is ready [(docu)]({docu_extracting})
abort.files_deleted: Datasource deleted, this may affect existing routes
abort.stop_incorrect:
Start and/or End destination incorrect, 
 possibly no transport 'today' or not in same direction, 
 please check logs
abort.no_data_file: Data collection issue: URL incorrect or filename not in the correct folder
abort.no_stops: Data collection issue: probably no stops for the selected route
abort.no_destination: No stop can be reached from the selected origin in this direction
abort.no_zip_file: Data collection issue: ZIP file not existing in the correct folder, note that it is capital-sensitive
abort.stop_limit_reached:
Detected a high number of stops for this radius, 
possibly impacting system performance. 
 You can change the limit at your own risk before changing the radius.
abort.extracting: (Still) extracting data, this will take time [(docu)]({docu_extracting})
abort.extraction_failed: Extracting the data of this datasource failed, see Settings > Repairs for the reason [(docu)]({docu_extracting})

routes_missing.title: GTFS datasource {datasource} was built without some routes
routes_missing.description:
The feed of datasource '{datasource}' has no trips for these routes it should keep: {routes}.

The datasource was built with its other routes. The missing routes come back by themselves once an update of the feed has trips for them again. If they are gone for good, remove them with 'Choose the routes an existing data source keeps' in the GTFS2 menu.

from_time.name: The time after which departures are collected
from_time.description:
The time after which you would like to receive the slots. 
 If left empty then all future slots will be extracted for today/tomorrow. 
 In yaml this has to be 24H format
